result.reason: The duration and documentation-conformance language reaches the preferred 12-month software/Deliverable and 90-day Services periods, but the operative text does not establish the required professional-and-workmanlike, legal-compliance, or no-malicious-code warranties except through an unverifiable reference to Section 19.1. Likewise, it does not expressly provide repair, replacement, or refund, instead relying on an unspecified Section 19.4. The addition of all other remedies is broader than necessary and may override an agreed remedy limitation. Also, stating that Services “conform to the warranties” is imprecise; the clause should directly warrant how Services are performed.
